content.value_statement: Outreach teams need consistent, respectful messages and clear follow-up plans. This skill creates tailored pitches, negotiation support, and pipeline trackers from the details you provide.
actual_capabilities: Draft personalized outreach for creators, journalists, analysts, hunters, and launch partners.
Create short direct messages, formal emails, and message variations.
Build a four-touch follow-up cadence with an archive point.
Prepare negotiation scripts for rate, scope, and value-exchange discussions.
Produce a pipeline tracker with stages, next actions, and conversion metrics.
limitations: It relies on campaign and contact information supplied by the user.
It does not send emails, direct messages, or schedule outreach automatically.
It does not verify audience data, rates, or recent creator activity without user-provided information.
It does not create binding contracts or finalize signed agreements.

use_cases.title: Launch a creator campaign
use_cases.description: Create tailored pitches and follow-ups for a selected group of creators.

use_cases.title: Re-engage past partners
use_cases.description: Use prior rates and contact history to prepare a respectful renewal message.

use_cases.title: Prepare a media outreach sequence
use_cases.description: Turn approved angles and embargo terms into concise outreach and tracking steps.

prompt_templates.title: Write a first outreach message
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a friendly outreach email to @creator for our skincare launch. They create eco-lifestyle content and have 45,000 Instagram followers.

prompt_templates.title: Create a follow-up cadence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-touch follow-up sequence for these creators. Use Days 0, 4, 8, and 14. Include a polite opt-out.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a rate objection
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare negotiation options for a creator asking for $3,000 when our budget is $2,000. Preserve a respectful tone and offer scope alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Build a campaign pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outreach pipeline for 20 creator prospects. Include stages, next actions, response metrics, and priorities for today.

output_examples.input: Write outreach for an eco-lifestyle creator for an organic skincare launch.
output: Personalization points based on the supplied creator profile.
A primary email, a short direct message, and a formal management version.
A clear invitation, compensation placeholder, and low-pressure next step.

output_examples.input: Plan follow-up for creators who have not replied.
output: Day 0: send the tailored first message.
Days 4 and 8: send shorter reminders with new value.
Day 14: send a final respectful check-in, then archive at Day 21.

best_practices: Use verified creator details and approved campaign claims before sending any message.
Offer a clear value exchange and make declining easy.
Review rates, deliverables, and contact history before negotiating.
anti_patterns: Do not use generic messages that ignore the recipient’s work and audience.
Do not send more than three or four follow-ups without a response.
Do not invent audience data, prior partnerships, quotes, or product claims.

faq.question: Does this skill send outreach messages?
faq.answer: No. It prepares outreach artifacts for the user to review and send.

faq.question: Which targets can it support?
faq.answer: It supports creators, journalists, analysts, hunters, launch partners, and advocates.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide campaign context, target details, budget, deliverables, timeline, and relevant contact history.

faq.question: Can it negotiate partnership rates?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest respectful scripts and scope alternatives, but the user makes final decisions.

faq.question: Can it use my CRM data?
faq.answer: It can work from CRM details you provide. The skill does not connect to or update a CRM itself.

faq.question: Does it create contracts?
faq.answer: No. Use a contract-focused process to create or finalize binding agreements.
